notes.title: v0.2 Update
notes.notes:
1.In [Story Mode], When HP reaches 0, it can be resurrected to continue the game.
2. Added the option to [ONLY STORY] continuously without engaging in combat. *In this mode, it is not possible to experience all combat related content.

notes.title: Official Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495534/a4db08ec91f7b665b045b399e505ccd1772c486d.jpg[/img]

Dear Players,

Thank you for your long-standing support! The new sensation bishoujo game, combining "bullet-hell shooting" and "visual novel," DreamlessGirl is now officially launched on Steam. The game is unlocked（Scheduled for December 13, 2024, at 6:00AM(PT)） for download, and we look forward to breaking dreams with you!

[h3]💉 "Rose-Hued Uniforms" Skin Expansion Pack[/h3]
The DLC skin expansion pack "Rose-Hued Uniforms" is also available now. Purchasing this pack unlocks three skins for mecha characters. Once applied, these skins will change the appearance of the corresponding mecha and character illustrations during gameplay, adding a new layer of excitement to the shooting experience.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320290/

[h3]🏷️ Launch & Bundle Discounts[/h3]
A one-week launch discount is now live! Purchase the game before December 19 to enjoy a 10% discount, with a regional price of 6.29$. Additionally, the DreamlessGirl Deluxe Bundle offers the base game and skin expansion pack together at an extra 10% off, for a total price of only 8.35$.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2242840/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48362/

We look forward to your purchase and wish you a fantastic gaming experience!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Follow Our New Projects〜(๑´ω`ﾉﾉﾞ[/h3]

notes.title: Release Date Confirmed!
notes.notes:
Dear Players:

Thank you for your patience and support over the long wait. "DreamlessGirl" has now completed all scheduled development, testing, and approval work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495534/58b9fac010eb0a65d469ccfd4e4c2784626e5984.jpg[/img]

[h3] We are excited to announce that the official version will launch on Xbox and Steam platforms on December 12, 2024! [/h3]

The Steam release will include the main game and a skin pack DLC, scheduled to unlock at 3:00 PM(GMT+8:00) on the 12th. We’ve also prepared a launch discount and bundle offers, and we look forward to your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2242840/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320290/
Add the game to your wishlist to receive the latest release updates!

The ✈︎ ⋆｡˚Beautiful Girl Bullet Hell Visual Novel Dreamless Girl, scheduled for release in Q4, is participating in Steam’s “Planes, Trains, and Automobiles Fest.” We’ve prepared brand new content for the occasion——

[h3]⋄ DEMO Update & Store Page Release ⋄[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495534/fb88d17fcfbccfbc4346a1f277606e82768fcc0c.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2264070/_DreamlessGirl_Demo/

[h3]⋄ Brand-new trailer and game content ⋄[/h3]
